mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major source of energy for terrestrial life."
Radiant energy from the Sun is the major source of energy for terrestrial life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known by the class it belongs and those characters that distinguished one plant from another are purely hereditary."
A crop or plant is known by the class it belongs and those characters that distinguished one plant from another are purely hereditary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the terminal acceptor of electron in the electron transport system."
Oxygen is the terminal acceptor of electron in the electron transport system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental feature of all known life."
Reproduction is a fundamental feature of all known life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the outcome of cell division, enlargement of the new cells and their differentiation into different types of tissues."
Growth in a plant is the outcome of cell division, enlargement of the new cells and their differentiation into different types of tissues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ultimate of all the changes and motion of the atmosphere and it is the single most important control of climate."
Radiation is the ultimate of all the changes and motion of the atmosphere and it is the single most important control of climate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formation of offspring without the fusion of gametes."
Asexual reproduction is the formation of offspring without the fusion of gametes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formation of offspring by the fusion of gametes."
Sexual reproduction is the formation of offspring by the fusion of gametes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as short-wave incoming radiation."
The shortwave radiation is referred to as short-wave incoming radiation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the specific wavelengths of light; light intensity is the degree of brightness that a plant receives; and day length is the duration of the day with respect to the night period."

Light quality refers to the specific wavelengths of light; light intensity is the degree of brightness that a plant receives; and day length is the duration of the day with respect to the night period.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of water vapour in the air, expressed as the proportion (in percent) of the maximum amount of water vapor it can hold at certain temperature."
Relative Humidity Relative humidity (RH) is the amount of water vapour in the air, expressed as the proportion (in percent) of the maximum amount of water vapor it can hold at certain temperature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the fleshy substances that usually surround seeds."
Fruits are the fleshy substances that usually surround seeds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major factors associated with limitations in growth of most plants."
Drought stress is one of the major factors associated with limitations in growth of most plants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a raw material in photosynthesis."
Carbon dioxide is a raw material in photosynthesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the biological process by which new individual organisms - "offspring" - are produced from their "parents"."
Reproduction (or procreation or breeding) is the biological process by which new individual organisms - "offspring" - are produced from their "parents".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most abundant protein in plants and therefore, the major consumer of nitrogen."
Rubisco is the most abundant protein in plants and therefore, the major consumer of nitrogen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those factors that are environmental in nature to the plant."
External factors are those factors that are environmental in nature to the plant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the deferential distribution of photosynthates to plant tissues."
Photosynthate partitioning is the deferential distribution of photosynthates to plant tissues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an empirical model of the evolution of a quantity over time."
A growth curve is an empirical model of the evolution of a quantity over time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the pericarp and consists of three layers."
The surrounding ovary tissue is called the pericarp and consists of three layers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mode of reproduction in Algae such as Spirogyra."
Fragmentation is the mode of reproduction in Algae such as Spirogyra.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the change in structure and function that results in cell, tissue and organ specialisation."
Differentiation is the change in structure and function that results in cell, tissue and organ specialisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the photosynthetic assimilation using water, CO2 and light energy."
The principal process is the photosynthetic assimilation using water, CO2 and light energy.

According to the course material, how many types of root systems in plants are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two basic types of root systems in plants: taproot systems and fibrous root systems.  Taproot systems feature a single, thick primary root, called the taproot, with smaller secondary roots growing out from the sides.
